messages:
maya: FYI customer AcmeRetail reporting large number of 5xx + p95 spikes on /v1/rerank starting ~09:20 PDT. They see intermittent 502/504s, lots of retries. Opening thread for triage.
sahil: I can confirm alerts: rerank.gateway.p95 jumped from 1.2s -> 5.1s around 09:19:30. 502 rate ~4x. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/rerank/d/abc123
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-456 created and paged eng-oncall.
liam: quick look at router logs: repeated upstream 504s from backend_reranker-*/pod. Gateway retried 3 times by default, then returned 502 to client. Sample log: 
```
[09:20:12] gateway request_id=abc123 upstream=backend_reranker-7 status=504 retry=2 latency_ms=4100
[09:20:12] gateway request_id=abc123 response=502 to_client
```
maya: Customer repro I ran locally (staging credentials) — large candidates payload fails consistently: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/re-rank -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"query":"x","candidates":[...500 items...]}' -v
# After ~4s server returns 504
```
elaine: They send bursts of small concurrent requests too (8 concurrent rerank requests with large candidate lists). That can cause queueing on workers and KV cache thrash.
sahil: runtime metrics show worker CPU/alloc spikes and GC pauses coincident with p95 spikes. Also KV cache eviction rate increased ~10x. My hypothesis: large candidate lists + prefetching/batched kvcache lookups causing kernel fallback and long tails.
jordan: Immediate mitigations we can try: 1) reduce rerank worker concurrency to 32 on the fleet, 2) lower gateway retry budget to 1 for rerank route, 3) add a temporary max_candidates size of 200 returning 413 to client. Any objections?
maya: agree with mitigations. We should also notify customer and offer a workaround: throttle client-side concurrency and trim candidate lists.
liam: Proposed rollout plan: 
- 09:40: lower concurrency for rerank pool to 32 (hot config)
- 09:45: set gateway retry_budget=1 for /v1/rerank routes
- 09:50: deploy route-level validation to cap candidates to 200 (soft 413)
- 10:00: monitor p95/gc/eviction metrics
If p95 normalizes, schedule follow-up for kvcache tuning + kernel perf.
elaine: Repro steps for SRE in staging: 
1) seed staging with a kvcache populate script (see gist)
2) run k6: `k6 run --vus 8 --duration 5m rerank-large.js` where rerank-large.js posts 400 candidates per request
3) watch `redis.evictions` & `runtime.gc.pause_ms` and gateway p95
(example commands in gist: https://gist.redwood/repro-rerank)
sahil: longer-term fixes: - add bulkhead per-customer to limit concurrency - disable prefetch on rerank path or make it size-aware - add model fallback to smaller variant under load - improve kernel selection for long candidate sequences
maya: Customer impact note: AcmeRetail reported this affected a subset of production users (reduced conversions). They asked if billing is affected — 5xx means requests not charged; we've informed billing.
jordan: I'm kicking off tickets: RWK-2112 (hotfix concurrency), RWK-2113 (route cap), RWK-2114 (post-mortem + kvcache tuning). Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-sre.
liam: After lowering concurrency we already saw p95 drop from 5.1s -> 1.4s and 502s reduced. Continued monitoring for 30m.
elaine: Adding note: please collect backend_reranker heap profiles and nvprof for a couple of spike windows if it recurs.
sahil: marking this thread for postmortem. I'll add traces and representative logs to RWK-2114.
maya: Thanks all. @AcmeRetail support rep will update customer with mitigation and ask for trimmed payloads. :thumbsup:
